thread:
support-lisa: FYI customer escalations from two enterprise tenants reporting intermittent 5xx and long timeouts hitting hosted inference endpoints since ~09:12 UTC. Several support tickets opened.
incident-bot: Alert: hosted-inference.gateway.errors spike (p95 latency up 4x) — auto-created incident channel.
sre-aaron: jumping in — are these 502/504 or 500s? any pattern in models or regions?
support-lisa: mostly 504s and gateway 502s. Both eu-west and us-west. Affected endpoints are /v1/generate with r=production-large models.
eng-nick: are requests building up in batcher queues? can you paste a trace id or request id from tickets?
support-lisa: sent request ids in DM. Example id: req_202172784912_01 (ticket #2312). Customers say retries briefly helped then back to 504.
runtime-kim: looking at metrics — batcher queue depth spiked at 09:10 and stayed elevated for ~12m. We also saw increased KV cache miss rate for the same model family.
sre-aaron: suspect prefix cache churn + large-sequence requests causing slow token generation => gateway timeouts. Any deploys around 09:00?
eng-nick: no production deploys from infra at that time. But there was a canary rollout of a new quantized runtime on dedicated-pool-3 at ~08:55 — probably unrelated but rolling back to be safe.
ops-maya: i'm scaling up the dedicated pool and temporarily increasing router timeout to 120s for affected routes to reduce customer-facing 504s. Doing a controlled throttle on heavy clients.
runtime-kim: quick mitigation checklist: 1) revert canary on dedicated-pool-3 2) bump batcher concurrency heuristic to force earlier flush 3) enable sticky routing to healthy instances 4) evict hot keys to warm nodes; rolling restart of a subset to repopulate cache.
sre-aaron: please run rollback now (nick), and kim/ops do the router timeout and batcher tweak. I’ll monitor circuit-breaker tripping thresholds.
eng-nick: rolling back canary now — `kubectl rollout undo deployment/quant-runtime -n hosted --to-revision=24` (watching pods).
eng-nick: rollback complete, new pods terminating old ones.
ops-maya: router timeout set to 120s for route /v1/generate (can revert after stabilization). Throttling heavy keys via rate-limit rule applied.
runtime-kim: batcher concurrency changed: `BATCH_FLUSH_MS=12` -> `8` for the group, pushing earlier flush. Applying to staging then prod now.
sre-aaron: seeing p95 latency drop, KV miss rate beginning to fall. Gateway 504s reduced by ~70% in last 6m. Good.
support-lisa: notifying customers with interim message: "We identified a backend congestion issue and implemented mitigations (rollback + routing change). Expect improved success rates; our next update in 30m."
product-olga: please document customer impact (tenants, approximate failed requests, timeline) and a postmortem owner. We should offer credits if SLA impacted.
eng-nick: assigning postmortem owner: runtime-kim will lead. Action items: 1) postmortem draft in 48h 2) permanent fix proposal for cache warming and batcher heuristics 3) automatic canary kill if latency delta >20% 4) update runbooks to include this rollback path.
runtime-kim: agreed. I'll own postmortem and start a follow-up doc.
sre-aaron: small follow-ups: add an alert for KV miss rate correlated with batch queue depth, and contact ops to evaluate autoscaler thresholds for dedicated pools.
ops-maya: noted — will open infra task for autoscaler threshold review and add a playbook step to temporarily increase router timeouts during mitigations.
support-lisa: closing loop with customers: sent confirmation messages and ETA for full postmortem. Customers acknowledged.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: hosted-inference.gateway spike contained. Severity: Sev2. Duration ~34m.
runtime-kim: action item list (summarized): [1] postmortem (48h) [2] add KV-cache warmers for hot models (proposal 1w) [3] autoscaler tuning (ops, 2w) [4] canary rollback automation on latency/regression (eng, 2w) [5] update CS customer communication template (support, asap).
eng-nick: I'll add the automated rollback PR and a canary health-check that watches p95 and error-rate.
sre-aaron: tagging owners in JIRA and creating incident follow-up board.
support-lisa: thanks all. I'll keep channel updated if customers reopen. :thumbsup:
